text: The Banach fixed-point theorem requires: a function T: X → X on a complete metric space is a contraction if:
choices: d(Tx,Ty) ≤ k·d(x,y) for some k<1 and all x,y
explanation: Contraction mapping: ∃k<1 ∀x,y: d(Tx,Ty)≤k·d(x,y). Then T has a unique fixed point (Banach's theorem). Used to prove existence/uniqueness for ODEs (Picard).
